The position ensures that protection monitoring and analysis activities of IRC and its local partners are aligned with the Protection Analytical Framework, organizational standards, and evolving operational priorities. The role provides direct supervision to the Protection Officer – Data Analysis (Rule of Law) and Protection Officer – Localization (Rule of Law), and technical supervision for field and local partners staff, engaged in PM-related activities, ensuring effective delivery of protection analysis activities, partner engagement, capacity-strengthening initiatives, and analytical outputs. This role manages design and implementation of protection monitoring tools and methodologies, overseeing quantitative and qualitative data analysis, facilitation of and producing regular protection monitoring reports and protection analysis updates. In collaboration with the Advocacy Unit, the role supports the development of policy briefs and advocacy products grounded in protection monitoring findings. It also engages in external ProL representation, coordination with Protection Cluster and technical working groups, and capacity strengthening of IRC and partner staff. Tool Development, Inputs & Updates: Designing and updating PM tools, including ad-hoc and thematic monitoring mechanisms as needed by programs or partners. Report Writing: Oversee and quality assure the production of protection analysis reports, thematic briefs, dashboards, area-based analyses, and protection monitoring updates prepared by the PA&R Unit Integration of Protection & PM into Programming: Ensure protection monitoring and analysis findings systematically inform program design, implementation, adaptation, and learning across PRoL, CP, WPE, ERD and Health teams. Advocacy & Policy Engagement: In cooperation with Sn Liaison and Advocacy Manager, strengthening the PM-advocacy nexus and developing policy briefs, evidence-based recommendations and practical solutions, policy analysis and advocacy efforts grounded in PM data. External Representation: Represent IRC in relevant technical working groups, analytical forums, information management groups (PRMS Steering Committee), and inter-agency initiatives, as delegated by the Protection Coordinator (Rule of Law). PM & Communications Coordination: Enhancing visibility and awareness of PM findings, ensuring their strategic dissemination. Contribute technical inputs to Protection Cluster analytical processes, Protection Risk Monitoring initiatives, joint assessments, thematic analyses, and area-based analytical exercises. Partner Collaboration & Participatory Approaches: Strengthening partnership-PM collaboration to integrate participatory best practices into PM activities. Overseeing partners in PM ensuring effective engagement with local partners contributing to protection monitoring and analysis. Support partner onboarding, capacity strengthening, quality assurance, and meaningful incorporation of community perspectives into analytical outputs. Capacity Building: Developing the analytical capacity of the IRC and its local partners teams in data collection, PM methodologies, protection mainstreaming, and data analysis. This could also include work on an IRC PM handbook tailored for Ukrainian (and not only) teams and partners, particularly those with limited PM experience. Being a People Manager Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue, and reflection at team level to strengthen safeguarding, wellbeing and duty of care, and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies. Lead by example and support IRC’s commitment to taking all necessary preventive measures and creating an environment where people feel safe and can report misconduct.
